reasoning: The agent proactively stress-tested the highest-risk invariants (hub-kill, node-kill, seq density, resume) and its upfront design already isolated seq allocation in a durable DB authority, so reality rarely diverged from the premise. This exceeds a plain 5 (targeted diagnosis/correction) because of the disciplined early stress-testing, but falls short of 8/10 because no falsified assumption ever forced a genuine re-architecture — the design held, so we cannot observe re-architecture-on-divergence behavior.
